chats_spell_needs_quest.name: chats_spell_needs_quest
chats_spell_needs_quest.value: "chats"."spell" is null or "chats"."quest_id" is not null

murmlings_type_valid.name: murmlings_type_valid
murmlings_type_valid.value:
("murmlings"."type" = 'task' and "murmlings"."task_number" > 0 and "murmlings"."task_number" is not null)
        or ("murmlings"."type" in ('plain', 'quick-note') and "murmlings"."task_number" is null
          and not "murmlings"."checked_off" and not "murmlings"."recurring")

users_name_normalized.name: users_name_normalized
users_name_normalized.value: "users"."name" is null or ("users"."name" = btrim("users"."name") and "users"."name" <> '' and char_length("users"."name") <= 60 and "users"."name" !~ '[{}\r\n]')
